scope: Unconfigured clocks follow actual current UTC instead of advancing 37 seconds per timestamp request and freezing while idle
Explicit base_time retains deterministic steps and reaches runtime during Scenario reset; undated seed events follow that clock while explicit dates stay unchanged
A subsequent unpinned Scenario restores live time; invalid clock resets preserve every account and the clock
Scenario export retains clock choice without native mutation
Event and recurring-instance lists return the authenticated user's current subscription default reminders across aliases and pagination

reference.relevant_contract: Default reminders are user-specific CalendarList metadata and are also returned by Events list. This metadata is separate from timed reminder delivery and change-notification delivery.

operator_test_corrections: Initial fixture assumed a primary calendar existed in empty state; it now creates an owned calendar
Initial GET assertion expected byte-identical event-time JSON; existing API normalizes Z to +00:00 and adds UTC timeZone. Final assertion preserves the same instant and native timestamp fields.

hosted.plan: Fresh live and fixed CLI Scenarios, full owner/reader state comparisons, browser settings/reload reads, all six container images, serving API/proxy digests and both teardowns

limits: No timed reminder/email or daily agenda delivery implementation
Personal event-level override isolation and broader notification/access/AI/collaboration remain open
No exhaustive frontend/visual/mobile/touch or sample release claim
